title: UnitedHealthcare app for members
summary: Overview of what the UnitedHealthcare app lets members do, from finding care and pricing to viewing claims, ID cards and virtual care.

assets.alt: Woman holding a phone with the app open

atoms.title: The UnitedHealthcare app
atoms.question: What is the UnitedHealthcare app?
atoms.text: The UnitedHealthcare app is a mobile app that connects members to their health plan details anytime, anywhere. It is designed to give members instant access to the answers and support they need, with 24/7, always-there access to their plan.
questions: What is the UHC app?
What does the UnitedHealthcare app do?

atoms.title: Find care and pricing in the app
atoms.question: Can I find providers and estimate costs in the UnitedHealthcare app?
atoms.text: In the UnitedHealthcare app, members can search for network providers near them, see ratings and reviews, and estimate out-of-pocket costs for different types of visits.
questions: How do I find a network doctor in the UHC app?
Can I estimate my out-of-pocket costs in the app?

atoms.title: Check benefits and coverage in the app
atoms.question: How do I check my copay and coinsurance in the app?
atoms.text: The UnitedHealthcare app lets members find copay and coinsurance amounts, view plan spending and see how their plan covers different types of care and services.
questions: Where can I see my copay in the UnitedHealthcare app?
How do I see what my plan covers?

atoms.title: Refill prescriptions from the app
atoms.question: Can I refill prescriptions in the UnitedHealthcare app?
atoms.text: Members can request prescription refills right from the UnitedHealthcare app. They can also look up drug prices and search for pharmacies near them.
questions: How do I refill a prescription in the UHC app?
Can I look up drug prices in the app?

atoms.title: View claims in the app
atoms.question: Can I check my claims status in the UnitedHealthcare app?
atoms.text: The UnitedHealthcare app lets members check the status of new and past claims. For each claim, members can see the amount billed, what the plan paid and how much they owe.
questions: How do I see my claims in the UHC app?
Where can I see how much I owe on a claim?

atoms.title: Plan ID cards and digital wallets
atoms.question: Can I show my insurance card from my phone?
atoms.text: Members can view and show their UCard or member ID cards in the UnitedHealthcare app when they need them. They can also add their health plan details to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.
questions: Can I put my UnitedHealthcare ID card in Apple Wallet?
Where do I find my digital insurance card?

atoms.title: Virtual care through the app
atoms.question: Can I schedule a virtual visit in the UnitedHealthcare app?
atoms.text: If a member's plan includes the benefit, they may be able to schedule a virtual visit through the UnitedHealthcare app for urgent care, routine care and more.
questions: How do I start a virtual visit from the UHC app?
Does the UnitedHealthcare app offer telehealth?

atoms.title: Are all app features available on every plan?
atoms.question: Are all UnitedHealthcare app features available for every plan?
atoms.text: No. Not all features are available for every plan, and some plans are not currently supported by the UnitedHealthcare app. Members can check which features apply to them after signing in.
questions: Why can't I see some features in the UnitedHealthcare app?
Does the UHC app work with my plan?

atoms.title: How to download or access the app
atoms.question: How do I get the UnitedHealthcare app?
atoms.text: 1) Use a mobile device to scan the QR code on the app page to download the UnitedHealthcare app. 2) If you only have a desktop or tablet, register or sign in to your member account instead, which gives access to the member site.
questions: How do I download the UnitedHealthcare app?
How do I register if I only have a computer?

atoms.title: Cost estimates are not guarantees
atoms.question: Are the cost estimates in the app guaranteed?
atoms.text: All UnitedHealthcare members can access a cost estimate online or on the mobile app. None of the cost estimates are intended to be a guarantee of costs or benefits, and actual costs may vary. Members are directed to the website or mobile application terms of use under Find Care & Costs.
questions: Can I rely on UnitedHealthcare cost estimates?
Is the estimated cost the actual price I will pay?

atoms.title: Family health information in one place
atoms.question: Can the whole family use one app for health plan information?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare describes the app as making it easier to have the whole family's medical information in one place.
questions: Can I manage my family's plan in one app?
Does the UHC app support family members?
